patterns.comment: Only '//' opens a comment. ';' used to be highlighted as one here, but the lexer in lmc_lsp has never accepted it — a ';' line was coloured as a comment while the server reported 'mnémonique attendu' on it.
patterns.name: comment.line.double-slash.lmc

patterns.comment: Label definition: a name at the start of a line followed by ':'. The ':' is what makes this unambiguous — before it was mandatory, every identifier had to be coloured as a label, operands included.
Label reference in operand position — anything left after keywords and numbers have had their turn.
patterns.name: variable.other.lmc
